items.title: Hackers Could Execute Commands on WordPress, Email and Print Servers Through Upload2Shell Flaw
items.description: A flaw in Ghostscript let researchers run commands on WordPress, Roundcube webmail, and Linux print servers through routine file processing. The vulnerability, dubbed Upload2Shell and tracked as CVE-2026-125396, affects upstream Ghostscript releases before 10.08.0. It sits in the software’s Type 1 font loader, but the affected servers did not need to expose Ghostscript directly. Their […] The…

items.title: GnuPG Warns Critical GPGME Flaw Could Expose App Data via Malicious OpenPGP Keys
items.description: A malicious OpenPGP key with an unusually long user ID can trigger a critical memory bug in GPGME, the standard library that programs use to work with GnuPG. The GnuPG project warned yesterday that the flaw could be used to steal data from affected applications and has released fixed versions.
